en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, ornate brick school building in historicist style with stepped gables and a central clock. The building stands on a small hill above an unpaved road, with a few people—likely children—walking or standing in the foreground. Trees line the right side of the scene, and smaller houses are visible on the left. Printed red caption text at the bottom reads "Grimma. Realschule." and a publisher's line "2776 Brück & Sohn, Meissen."
